title: Characteristic polynomial of an idempotent endomorphism over a field
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $n\ge0$, $V=k^{\oplus n}$ and $p:V\to V$ a $k$-linear map with $p\circ p=p$. Let $r=\dim_k\operatorname{Im}(p)$. Then the characteristic polynomial of $p$ [def-weil-pbc-charpoly-free-module] (computed in any basis [lem-weil-pbc-charpoly-free-module-properties]) is $\det(T-p)=(T-1)^rT^{n-r}\in k[T]$. In particular it divides $T^n(T-1)^n$ in $k[T]$.

source.place: More on Algebra, proof of Lemma Tag 07M5 (lemma-lift-projective-module, line 2020): 'For every prime p containing I the image of f in kappa(p) is (x-1)^r x^{n-r} where r is the dimension of P-bar (x) kappa(p)' (stated without proof)
